name: W Futanari Musume Kyousei Keikaku ~Tenkousei mo Jikkendai ni Shite Shimae!
original_name: Wフタナリ娘矯正計画 転校生も実験台にしてしまえッ！
source:
The protagonist, Kagano, is a student who studies relentlessly every day with the goal of earning a doctorate in biology. With that as his sole focus, he made no friends and lived a life dedicated entirely to his studies—a school life that appeared somewhat lonely to those around him... or so it seemed.

However, due to a drug he created himself, he has ended up living together with his female classmate, Miki Osawa, who has become a futanari because of it.

Then, one day, a cute girl appeared before him and shouted: "That's why... I want you to use the drug you made to make my cock disappear! Please, make me a normal girl!"

[MTL translation from the [url=http://masterup.net/gokufero/product/whutanari/index.html]official site[/url]]
